g.text: Checked route (within the model), same destination

Comparison at each place's leave-by deadline toward the destination of its default checked route. Model-relative results for recorded 2025 fire scenarios (4 scenario members per input time, drawn per cell from the

forecast; 1-hour scenario window; OSM roads at an assumed 40 km/h, no congestion). Each place is checked to one of its three nearest OSM-mapped schools or community halls (not official shelters; for one Yeongdeok
place one of the three is an unnamed OSM amenity=shelter point). Not evacuation outcomes. Planning aid only - not for live evacuation operations.
